items.meta_description: VpnHood! – A free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
items.phone_alt: VpnHood! CONNECT app on a smartphone
items.li_no_limits: No traffic, bandwidth, or time limit
items.li_no_registration: No registration or personal data is required
items.features_desc: Enjoy secure and private access to the internet, regardless of the websites or applications you use.
items.f_security_desc: Protect your data with advanced encryption while staying anonymous by hiding your IP address and preventing tracking, ensuring safe, private browsing anywhere, anytime.
items.f_logs_desc: Enjoy true privacy with zero tracking your online activities are never recorded or stored.
items.f_leak_desc: Stay anonymous with advanced safeguards that prevent any accidental exposure of your IP address or DNS requests.
items.f_encryption_desc: Protect your data with robust encryption, ensuring secure communication from start to finish.
items.f_privacy_desc: Experience a smooth, encrypted connection that keeps your online presence confidential across various network environments.
items.resilient_desc: Our advanced infrastructure is built for maximum uptime. By utilizing dynamic server management and sophisticated protocols, we ensure your secure connection remains active and reliable, providing a seamless browsing experience without interruptions.
items.open_source_desc1: Built on open-source foundations, this feature guarantees full transparency and trust. The app's code is freely available for review, allowing users and experts to audit its security, verify its integrity, and ensure there are no hidden vulnerabilities.
items.open_source_desc2: VpnHood underwent a comprehensive security audit by the Open Tech Fund.
items.options_title: Everything you need in a VPN
items.options_desc: Gain complete control over your online security and unlock its full potential with advanced options tailored to your specific needs for an optimized, secure experience.
items.opt_protocols_desc: Including TCP and UDP, optimized for stable and high-speed connectivity.
items.opt_split_desc: Split traffic by countries, apps, IPs, and domains to save data, boost speed.
items.opt_dns_desc: Manage how website addresses are resolved by configuring Private DNS and Adapter DNS.
items.opt_kill_desc: Automatically blocks internet connection immediately if the VPN disconnects.
items.location_desc: Access our worldwide network of high-speed servers. Connect through multiple global locations to ensure a fast, private, and reliable connection wherever you are.
items.download_desc: Download our free VPN to access advanced security features. Enhance your digital protection and enjoy a private, encrypted browsing experience anywhere.
items.windows_note: Note: The Windows app does not have a free server.
items.manager_title: Running your own VPN for free
items.manager_desc: VpnHood enables anyone to create, manage, and share their own VPN, completely free of charge. Designed to resist blocking, it offers full control over server configurations. Fully transparent and open-source, VpnHood has been expertly audited by two leading security firms to ensure state-of-the-art protection.
items.m_projects_desc: Create unlimited projects for various services.
items.m_team_desc: Create your team and assign the rules to each member.
items.m_servers_desc: Add your servers and manage them from one platform.
items.m_farms_desc: Organize servers into group and create unique tokens.
items.m_profiles_desc: Generate reusable configurations for your servers.
items.m_monitor_desc: Track the server's status and usage from dashboard.
items.m_tokens_desc: Generate an access token for VPN connectivity for users.
items.m_token_profiles_desc: Simplify token creation by building reusable profiles.
